comparison.objective: Fit and index a servo horn on a splined shaft; candidate extracts a latched terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine rotational phase alignment and press-fit seating versus blade-under-tab insertion followed by coordinated tensile release.
comparison.success_condition: Horn flush at the zero spline index and released; candidate requires terminal exit with housing, crimp, and neighbors intact, while exact thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Precision insertion onto splines is meaningfully different from latch-mediated depinning.
